app.title: Htmx 4.0
app.author: rmsaksida
app.description: A lightweight JavaScript library that allows developers to add AJAX, CSS transitions, and more to HTML with special attributes, without writing JS code.
proposed_tests: Install via CDN or npm: `npm install htmx.org`
Create a minimal HTML page that uses `hx-get` to fetch a JSON endpoint
Measure the time from click to response rendering
Verify that dynamic content updates without full page reload
Run a performance test with 100 simultaneous `hx-get` requests
